about: What the opening (cutscene.js cutsceneScript at c7c5ad3+) said before it moved into story.json scripts.opening: lines in order with the opening commands between, slots filled with name Pat, starter Starterbill, counter Counterbill, foe Gildlet. tools/test/opening-script.test.mjs plays the script against it.

said.text: Oh! Another one! Are you all right? That was quite a landing.
You came down through the crust. Things do, now and then. Mostly furniture. You’re the first this week who can talk.
Can you tell me your name?
No? Nothing at all?
Classic fall-related amnesia. Very common down here. It usually comes back, a bit at a time.
Let’s start with what we can see. Sit up, let me get a good look at you.
Pat? It suits you. If it isn’t your name, it is now.
I’m Professor Hazel. I study Billies, the most common wildlife here in the Hollow Earth.
Clones of the richest people up top. A lab backed them up and filled the gaps with animals, then shipped the results down here. They went wild.
They live in the long grass, in caves and canyons, even in the malls. Walk, and they come to you. Tax them with a coin, train a team, earn badges from the arena leaders.
Nobody should walk the Hollow Earth alone. Luckily for you, I have three of them right here.
Professor! Professor! Did another one fall in?
I’m Blake. Blake Sterling. My father is Sterling Sterling the Third. Sterling Capital? You’ve heard of it.
New kids have to battle me. It’s a tradition. I started it this morning.
They don’t have a Billie yet, Blake.
Then they forfeit! Unless somebody wants to fight for them.
Oh, I’d love to.
You don’t even have a Billie.
I have tenure.
That’s not fair! You don’t even have a type!
Everyone has a type, Blake. Mine is “tenured”.
Now. Where was I? Ah, yes. Three of them, right here.
Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Take a good look before you choose!
Starterbill! Pat and Starterbill. I like the sound of that.
Since SOMEONE flattened Gildlet, I’m taking Counterbill. It beats Starterbill. No offence. Well, a little offence.
Come on, surface stray. Battle me! A real one this time!
